text:
maria: Pushed changes to PR #4821 — moved retry backoff into RetryConfig, added a unit test for jitter, lowered the default batch executor timeout from 30s to 20s. Also added a brief migration note in CHANGELOG.
ryan: Thanks — quick Q: do we preserve the old env var name for backwards compatibility?
maria: Yes, kept a small shim. New var is REDWOOD_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS; legacy REDWOOD_BACKOFF_MS still reads through and logs a deprecation warning. See the second commit.
hanni: Left one tiny naming nit in the test (assert message). Otherwise this looks fine to me :+1:
ryan: I'm running a quick local smoke now. Will comment if anything breaks.
ci-bot: build passed · unit-tests · 8m
josh: When we have an approver from infra I'm happy to take this into the limited canary window. Tag me after ryan approves with preferred slots.
ryan: Smoke looks clean, no regressions in latency distributions. Approving now.
maria: Thanks! josh — we prefer Tue 09:00 PT but can shift to Wed morning if needed.
josh: Booked Tue 09:00 PT, routing policy set to 10% traffic with fallback to standard endpoint. Rolling ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1298
ci-bot: mergeable: true · auto-merge queued
maria: merging after canary completes. If any post-canary regressions, I will revert and open a hotfix. Appreciate the quick reviews — cheers!
